name: Three Lesbians Learn French
source:
It's been several years since that fateful Snowmas when Trixie cosied up with her girlfriends and life's good. One day though, the domestic bliss of basically just crashing at Tabby's ever absent parent's house is shaken when communication breaks down between Tabby and Nikita, threatening to destroy their relationship forever.  Even worse? Trixie can't stop speaking French. Can she (and by extension you) save her relationship from disaster and herself from a life of eating stinky cheese?

[From [url=https://digital-poppy.itch.io/french-lesbians]Itch.io[/url]]
